name: basedcode
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Based code instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Based code tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Based code through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Based code Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Based code only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
